section_path: II. PECULIARITIES OF INDIVIDUAL APPLICATIONS Nos. 39919/07 AND 56947/10

text: On 23 November 2006, the Sabail District Court convicted the applicant under Article 310.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences, relying on the related administrative offence report.
section_path: II. PECULIARITIES OF INDIVIDUAL APPLICATIONS Nos. 39919/07 AND 56947/10

text: On 23 November 2006, the Sabail District Court sentenced the applicant to ten days' administrative detention.
section_path: II. PECULIARITIES OF INDIVIDUAL APPLICATIONS Nos. 39919/07 AND 56947/10

text: Similar decisions to the Sabail District Court's decision of 23 November 2006 appear to have been given in respect of a number of others arrested in connection with the demonstration of 23 November 2006.
section_path: II. PECULIARITIES OF INDIVIDUAL APPLICATIONS Nos. 39919/07 AND 56947/10

text: The applicant was not represented during the pre-trial stage of the administrative proceedings.
section_path: II. PECULIARITIES OF INDIVIDUAL APPLICATIONS Nos. 39919/07 AND 56947/10

section_path: II. PECULIARITIES OF INDIVIDUAL APPLICATIONS Nos. 39919/07 AND 56947/10

text: According to the applicant, following the trial, the applicant was unaware of the decision taken by the Sabail District Court as it was not announced by the judge during the hearing.
section_path: II. PECULIARITIES OF INDIVIDUAL APPLICATIONS Nos. 39919/07 AND 56947/10

text: The applicant was able to obtain a copy of the Sabail District Court's decision of 23 November 2006 several months after the trial.
section_path: II. PECULIARITIES OF INDIVIDUAL APPLICATIONS Nos. 39919/07 AND 56947/10

text: On 24 November 2006, E.Q., a lawyer, lodged an appeal against the Sabail District Court's decision of 23 November 2006 on behalf of several members of the Popular Front Party of Azerbaijan who had been detained, including the applicant.
section_path: II. PECULIARITIES OF INDIVIDUAL APPLICATIONS Nos. 39919/07 AND 56947/10

text: According to the applicant, there had been no contact between the applicant and E.Q. prior to E.Q. lodging the appeal.
section_path: II. PECULIARITIES OF INDIVIDUAL APPLICATIONS Nos. 39919/07 AND 56947/10

text: According to the applicant, the applicant was unaware of the appeal lodged by E.Q. on 24 November 2006.
